name: Scroll-scrubbed dashboard hero
purpose: The homepage's signature moment: a pinned hero whose dashboard screenshot grows from a 48px box to a full window as the user scrolls. Drive the brand's core claim before any product detail.

motion.detail: progress = clamp(scrollY / (heroHeight - viewportHeight), 0, 1), a plain LINEAR ramp with no easing, written to --progress. The clip reads it: width calc(48px + 1152px * p), height calc(48px + 592px * p), radius calc(1.5px + .5px * p). The inner image only fades in at the very end: opacity clamp(0, (p - 0.95) * 20, 1). Entrance stagger: news tag 0ms, h1 500ms, actions 750ms, clip 1000ms.
motion.reducedMotionDetail: The pin is dropped entirely (position:relative, height:auto) and the dashboard renders inline at full width. The clip is also excluded from the hero's exit animation, because it is the scrubbed element and must stay visible throughout.

mobile.note: The hero fills exactly one screen, so the scroll range is zero, --progress never advances, and the clip stays a 48x48 box. This is real live behaviour, not a degradation.

geometryWarning: All hero sizing is VIEWPORT-RELATIVE (100vh-based). CLONE_SPEC.md:186's flat '820px tall' claim is false at every viewport height except 900. Do not encode a pixel height here.
